about_the_game:
Talescape is a creative platform that lets anyone build and share interactive stories, without writing a single line of code. Write scenes, craft choices, and shape entire worlds through a visual editor designed for writers, not programmers.

Stories made in Talescape run seamlessly across Steam, iOS, and Android, turning imagination into playable experiences. Whether you want to build a branching visual novel, a choice-driven adventure, or a quiet story about memory. Talescape gives you the tools to bring it to life.

For Bards (Creators):

  • Visual editor for scenes, dialogues, and choices

  • No coding required, focus on storytelling

  • Automatic publishing to all major platforms

  • Earn transparent revenue: keep 55–70 % after taxes and fees

  • Built-in checks, debug tools, and team collaboration

For Dreamers (Players):

  • Discover interactive stories made by real people

  • Play anywhere, progress syncs across devices

  • Explore by emotion: Daydream, Nightmare, Vision, or Echo

  • Support independent creators directly

Talescape is developed by Aureola, an independent studio from Dortmund, Germany. Our mission is simple: to protect the space where imagination can speak freely and responsibly, and to keep stories alive for generations to come.

content_descriptors.notes: Talescape itself contains no explicit or adult content. However, it allows user-generated stories created by independent authors (“Bards”). Some stories may include mature themes or imagery if properly labeled according to Talescape’s Content Guidelines. Such content is optional, community-moderated, and clearly marked for age-appropriate audiences.

name: Talescape

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel UHD or equivalent)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard audio device
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection required for publishing, collaboration, and updates.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: ntegrated or dedicated GPU with 1 GB VRAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard audio device
  • Additional Notes: Recommended screen resolution 1280×720 or higher.

short_description: Talescape is a world for storytellers and dreamers. Create interactive stories without coding, publish them across platforms, and explore tales that move you, make you think, and stay with you long after they end.
